propositions: The two-clone enrichment regression for bug 8185 requires git merge-tree --write-tree, available only in Git 2.38+, but the repository does not declare or enforce this floor.
Test guards that skip on unsupported versions create vacuous tests that silently do not run, masking regressions rather than preventing them.
Git 2.38+ floor must be declared single-sourced, enforced to abort the entire test session on violation (not skip individual tests), and documented consistently across contributor docs and CI.
The merge-tree regression must remain collected and executed on all gating CI environments without conditional skipping.
Fail-closed guards searching the entire tests/ tree prevent module splits or renames from silently breaking the floor enforcement.
